{{Update |title1 = v1.42.0 |image1 = CommandoReworkThumb.png |release_date = 20 November 2024 (v1.42.0) |minor_updates = v1.42.0a (21 November 2024) |feed_title = 💥 Commando 💥 |feed_color = Orange |previous_update = [[v1.41.0|Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Update]] |next_update = [[v1.43.0]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.42.0''' is the ninety-fifth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 20th of November 2024. This update added the [[Commando]] rework. This update encompassed two updates, the v1.42.0 update (released 20 November 2024) and the minor v1.42.0a (released 21 November 2024). ==Additions== ===Skins=== *{{Color|Mission|Trooper}} [[Commando]] ===Miscellanous=== *'''T.D.S. Commandos''' [[Mission Quests|Mission]] ==Removals== ===Enemies=== :Multiple enemies were removed as they were part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. *[[Quick Pawn]] *[[Pawn]] *[[Brain Bound]] *[[Mind Shackled]] *[[Neuro Runner]] *[[Synaptic]] *[[Titus]] *[[Hex Spawn]] *[[Hex Minion]] *[[Hex Wraith]] *[[Hex Revenant]] *[[Forsaken Skull]] *[[Hex Corpse]] *[[Upper Body]] *[[Rotting Terror]] *[[Blight Walker]] *[[Conjurer (Hexscape)|Conjurer]] *[[Nightmarish Hulk]] *[[Hex's Maw]] *[[Conserver]] *[[Cursed Horror]] *[[Enigma (Hexscape)|Enigma]] *[[Eclipsed (Hexscape)|Eclipsed]] *[[Hex Drako]] *[[Corrupted Titus]] *[[Hex Weaver]] *[[Corrupted Conserver (Hexscape)|Corrupted Conserver]] *[[Reaper (Hexscape)|Reaper]] *[[Withered (Hexscape)|Withered]] *[[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] *[[Unknown Small]] *[[Unknown Boss]] ===Maps=== :Three maps were removed as they were part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. *[[Failed Gateway]] *[[The Nightmare Realm]] *[[Containment]] ===Miscellanous=== *[[Hexscape Event]] *[[Titus (Narrator)|Titus]] narrator *[[Conserver (Narrator)|Conserver]] narrator *[[Primordial Drakobloxxer (Narrator)|Primordial Drakobloxxer]] narrator ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Commando]] reworked. **Bullets now pierce through enemies. **[[Commando]] now fires in bursts, which end in a burst cooldown. Additionally, it has a limited amount of ammo. The firerate listed in its statistics box is actually the burst cooldown and not the time between each shot. **Missiles are now fired out with the ''Missile'' ability. ***Missile splash damage no longer has damage dropoff. ***One missile reloaded per cooldown. ***Missiles can be fired in its missile range, which is double of its regular range. ***Missiles stun enemies that were hit by it. ***If missiles do not hit an enemy, they will remain on the path for their lifespan, exploding when an enemy steps on them or their lifespan ends. **Placement limit of 8 added. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Damage increased from 2 to 6. ****Firerate decreased from 0.525 to 0.225. ****Burst cooldown of 0.525 added. ****Reload time of 2.5 added. ****Burst size of 3 added. ****Ammo of 30 added. ****Max hits of 2 added. ****Cost increased from {{Money|1,600}} to {{Money|2,250}}. ***'''Level 1''' ****Damage increased from +0 to +2. ****Range decreased from +2 to +0. ****Max hits increased from +0 to +1. ****Cost increased from {{Money|350}} to {{Money|935}}. ****Name changed from ''Radar Pack'' to ''Recon Mission''. ***'''Level 2''' ****Damage increased from +0 to +2. ****Range decreased from +2 to +1.5. ****Burst size increase of 3 > 5 added. ****Reload time change of 2.5 > 2 added. ****Ammo increased from +0 to +15. ****No longer unlocks missiles. ****Cost increased from {{Money|700}} to {{Money|3,250}}. ****Name changed from ''Disposable Missile'' to ''Titanium Rounds''. ***'''Level 3''' ****Damage increased from +2 to +5. ****Range increased from +1 to +1.5. ****Firerate changed from 0.525 to {{Tooltip|0.225 > 0.175|-0.05}}. ****Burst size increase of 5 > 6 added. ****Ammo increased from +0 to +15. ****Burst cooldown change of 0.525 > 0.375 added. ****Reload time change of 2 > 1.5 added. ****Max hits increased from +0 to +1. ****''Missile'' ability added. *****125 damage per missile. *****Fires out two missiles. *****1.25 stun time. *****Missile range is double of regular range (30). *****4 explosion range. *****60 missile lifespan when on the path. *****20 ability cooldown. ****Cost increased from {{Money|2,000}} to {{Money|8,500}}. ****Name changed from ''Recon Armor'' to ''Jericho Missiles''. ***'''Level 4''' ****Damage decreased from +6 to +1. ****Firerate changed from 0.525 to {{Tooltip|0.175 > 0.15|-0.025}}. ****Burst size increase of 6 > 10 added. ****Ammo increased from +0 to +20. ****Burst cooldown change of 0.375 > 0.325 added. ****Reload time change of 1.5 > 1.25 added. ****Missile damage increased from +4 to +50. ****Stun time change of 1.25 > 1.75 added. ****Missile range increased from +0 to +2. ****Explosion range increased from 4 to 4 > 6. ****Ability cooldown change of 20 > 10 added. ****Really cool armor tool tip added. ****Cost increased from {{Money|7,500}} to {{Money|20,000}}. ****Name changed from ''Quad Launcher'' to ''Death & Taxes''. ***'''Level 5 removed''' ****Original statistics: *****Name: ''Flex Armor'' *****Cost: {{Money|10,000}} ****+3 range ****+12 damage ****+6 missile damage **{{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} skin rarity changed from {{Color|Common}} to {{Color|Rare}}. *[[Commando]]'s all skins Level 0-4 appearance changed. *[[Commando]]'s Level 0-4 upgrade icons changed. *[[Commando]] is now obtainable through a gamepass for {{Robux|799}} until the 1st of December. *'''Wednesday the 30th''' and '''Dark Harvest''' no longer appear in [[Mission Quests]], '''T.D.S. Commandos''' now always appears in [[Mission Quests]] for next two days. **Number of slots for [[Mission Quests]] reduced from six to five for the time period that '''T.D.S. Commandos''' is guaranteed to appear, reduced further to four after these two days. *[[Battlepass Boost]] is now active on all maps. *[[Battlepass Boost]] currency boost increased from 50% to 100%. *Lobby updated. *Fixed [[Engineer]] sentry lifespans not scaling with [[Time Scale]] properly. *Fixed [[Fallen Honor Guard]] not using its ''For Honor'' ability. *Fixed [[Patient Zero]] receiving high damage from unit collisions when they dealt damage to its regenerated health. *Fixed [[Blizzard Bomb]] freezing effect having the possibility to not disappear, freezing enemies infinitely. *Fixed being able to select any tower from the loadout in [[Tutorial]], which allowed for them to be placed in spots that the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] did not request to be placed in. *Fixed players not being able to interact with emotes used by other players, such as the [[Gift]] or [[Conga]]. *Fixed {{Color|Lunar|Crossbow}} [[Turret]] skin not facing the correct way. :In '''v1.42.0a''': *Disabled revives. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} CommandoReworkThumb.png PLSDONATE.png HexscapeNight1Thumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} CommandoReworkIcon.png {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} V1.42.0Render.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log.
